The '''All-Terrain Tractor Locomotion System''' was a caterpillar locomotion unit for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] built by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. With their 928 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], such tread units were heavy, but they could still achieve high speeds with an average [[Battery/Legends|power]] usage. They were made of [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]]-[[Vanadium/Legends|vanadium]], [[Steel/Legends|steel]], medium-[[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] steel and [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]], all of which were of med-high durability. Due to their components, those locomotion systems were also magnetic.
